findings.title: RPK-05's pin is vacuous against weighting
findings.note: D-042 round-1 finding 2: the assertion counts a substring (always >= 0) and compares no rank/order between a classification word and an ordinary word; the uniform-tokenizer law is structurally real (no classification-word literal in query.py/commands.py source), but the pin adds no protection against a future weighting regression. Accepted: P5-B's eval corpus is the honest instrument for rank/order claims — the pin tightens there.

findings.title: RPK-07 pins only absence-of-A
findings.note: D-042 round-1 finding 3: owner B's pack is asserted free of A's ids but never asserted to CARRY B's own material — the isolation half is genuinely tested (the _read RLS path), the availability half is not. Accepted for this slice: the availability of the owner's own reads is pinned by RPK-01's own-owner pack contract.

findings.title: RPK-04's pin weaker than its registered claim
findings.note: D-042 round-1 finding 4: the pack output carries ids/provenance/trust (PACK_SQL selects no text column), so 'carries it verbatim' overstates and 'never executes' is unprobed (no state-delta marker, unlike the dispatch suite's A02 form). The law holds structurally (the read path is SQL-only; RPK-06 pins the write-refusal). Accepted: wording tightened in a later slice; the verbatim-carrying claim belongs to the pack CONTENT arm (P5-B).

findings.title: the budget's one-item floor (undeclared)
findings.note: D-042 round-1 finding 5: the truncation loop's 'and kept' guard admits the FIRST item regardless of budget (--budget-bytes 1 admits a 154-byte item, a 154x overrun of the bound). Item size is bounded (ids + matched terms). Accepted: the floor is now DECLARED here; the honest alternative (an empty pack on a sub-item budget) breaks the cursor contract's last-admitted-id semantics.

findings.title: records hygiene: run-01/run-04 same-command different-digest + the amendment chain's intermediate form
findings.note: D-042 round-1 findings 6+7: run-01 and run-04 record the same command at the same commit with digests differing only by the .txt companion's exit=0 trailer (nothing false recorded — both reproduce); the red-record amendment chain types 45d7ad4->84b0668 while the tree at 606d2c8 was 1d30ec0 (the intermediate scanner-collision form unregistered, no assertion touched across the span — verified by the reviewer). Accepted as hygiene debt; the fresh run records below supersede the pair.
